pages.title: Flows
pages._note: Custom page rather than type:index. A flow lives in OpenRegister's own native flow table, not in a register/schema, so the manifest's object-backed index cannot address it — index pages resolve rows through register+schema. The body is CnFlowIndexPage from the shared library, so the list, its app scoping and its status semantics stay identical across every app that shows flows.

pages.title: Flow
pages._note: Custom page: a direct-manipulation canvas over a node/edge document is not expressible as a widget grid, and the built-in detail type is record-shaped. Controls live in the NcAppSidebar (sidebarComponent) so the canvas gets the full width; the two halves share useFlowStore because they render in different parts of the tree.

observability._note: OpenRegister dogfoods its own AppHost observability engine (ADR-040). These descriptors reproduce the output of the now-deleted hand-written HealthController + MetricsController. The /api/health and /api/metrics routes are aliased to AppHost\Controller\GenericHealth#index / GenericMetrics#index in appinfo/routes.php, so the engine reads this block at request time. Parity: metric names, types and label keys match the pre-adoption contract; documented intentional improvements are the added health `app` field, the implicit `nextcloud_version` info label, and the objects_total register/schema labels now carrying numeric ids (engine tableCount groupBy) rather than titles.
